messages:
maya: Heads-up: customer reported saved-view "preview" cost wildly off when compare-mode + long contexts are used. Estimated $0.02 vs real $0.20.

ryan: That's bad. How do we currently compute preview?

lee: We sample recent calls, take median tokens, multiply by expected calls. We don't expand for compare-mode or rerankers, and we ignore KV cache hit-rate.

tina: UX ask: show a simple estimate but provide an "advanced" expanded breakdown and a "run detailed dry-run" option that is explicit about consuming quota.

maya: Suggestion: default compact line: "Est. cost (30d): $X" with a small chevron to expand model breakdown + CI band. Provide a secondary button "Detailed dry-run (may use quota)".

ryan: API change: POST /api/savedviews/preview?detailed=true|false. Detailed spawns sandboxed dry-run job and returns precise counts. Need Idempotency-Key and rate-limits.

lee: Backend will return model_breakdown + ci_lower/ci_upper when detailed=false. If detailed=true return actual_sample_counts and tokens_consumed.

ops-bot: Note: dry-run token usage will be logged to billing as dryrun_tokens_consumed.

tina: QA: add e2e comparing preview vs dry-run; flag routes with high variance.

ryan: Telemetry keys: savedview_preview_shown, savedview_preview_expanded, savedview_preview_dryrun_started, savedview_preview_dryrun_completed. Labels: route_id, models, ci_span. Also alert when ci_upper/ci_lower > 5.

maya: Rollout: behind FF, enable for internal + 2 pilot customers, collect two weeks of telemetry before wider rollout. Keep modal copy concise.

lee: I'll prototype API schema and rate-limits. ETA 3d.

maya: Thanks — I'll prepare the modal mock and the small help doc that explains why estimates vary.

(attachment: small screenshot of current preview UI and example dry-run logs)
